test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Rathan said, "I have written a poem."

options.text: Rathan said that he has written a poem.
Rathan said that I had written a poem.
Rathan said that he wrote a poem.
Rathan said that he had written a poem.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Rathan said that he had written a poem.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I have written" becomes "he had written"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject in reported speech.
 
• Present perfect tense "have written" is changed to past perfect "had written".
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Reported speech does not require quotation marks.
 
• Sentence structure is adjusted to fit indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Rathan said that he had written a poem.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Rathan said that he has written a poem." 

 
 
• Incorrect tense conversion: "has written" should be "had written" in reported speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Rathan said that I had written a poem." 
 
 
• Incorrect pronoun: "I" should be changed to "he".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Rathan said that he wrote a poem." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "wrote" should be "had written".
 
 

``
